defs.def: an object such as a knife, gun, bomb, etc. that is used for fighting or attacking sb 武器；兵器；凶器

ex.s: They work to disarm combatants and to secure weapons and ammunition, removing them from use.
ex.t: 他们努力解除战斗人员的武装，确保武器和弹药的安全，使其不再使用。

ex.s: At any moment, it seemed, a body of horsemen might be seen breaking out from the black trees, so many weapons might be heard and some distant spot of snow be reddened.
ex.t: 在任何时刻，似乎都可能看到一队骑手从黑黢黢的树林中冲出，如此多的兵刃铿锵声可闻，远处某个雪点可能会被染红。

ex.s: War is fought with terrifying and dreadful weapons.
ex.t: 战争是用令人恐惧而可怕的武器进行的。

ex.s: Perhaps I only had a better weapon.
ex.t: 或许我只不过拥有更好的武器。

defs.def: something such as knowledge, words, actions, etc. that can be used to attack or fight against sb/sth 武器，手段，工具（指用作攻击或斗争的知识、言语、行动等）

ex.s: Sound can be used as a weapon.
And yet some people say the greatest weapon of all is the power of human speech.
ex.t: 然而有些人说，最强大的武器莫过于人类言语的力量。

chunks.cn: 更好的武器 / 安心的武器
